_comment: The Stones Are Dimming, Act IV: The Five Hearts. The Glade first, then Greyseam, Highwatch, Crownstead and the Elden Road in any order, then the convergence. Uses all four mechanics; teaches Ember Legacy's choice (N3) through Sir Rowan and wardline routing (N1) at Crownstead. Format: see r1_act1.json.

lines.text: The Antlered Warden guards the stone. Don't kill it. Tire it. Then carve Bless while it watches.
It has guarded that stone longer than Valencious has had kings. Let it see who's asking.
The Warden lowers its antlers to the stone. Old light runs down them, blue as a river.
One heart. Four more: Greyseam, Highwatch, Crownstead, the Elden Road. Pick your road.
The one that scares you least. Save your courage. You'll want it for the last one.
Human in the deep seam. Brave, or lost?
Crown says: no orc picks in Crown rock. Rock does not read. Harrok's children eat.
The purple came up out of the seam. It eats lamp-light. My miners won't go down.
Then Harrok holds your torch. Strong blood.
Ha! A human who knows the words. Go. Tuskridge guards your back.
Alone is a short word. Short words break. Go, then.
Stone is lit. Miners sing again. Bad singing. Good sign.
Stone is lit. Harrok will tell the King an orc held the torch. He will hate it. Good.
Ah, the carver! Come up, come up. The wind's in a mood today.
My squire returns! Taller, and not one bit wiser. Excellent.
Cold since the first frost. Something comes down Grimfen Pass at night. Big. Violet-eyed.
We hold the gate. Then you carve. Then I buy you a truly terrible drink.
Ah. That one got under the shield. Sit with me a moment, young blade.
Seventy winters. The healer would laugh. Listen. I'd like to keep watch. Without the knees.
You carry it. Put it where it does the most good. The stone, young Tobin, or my old lance.
Highwatch holds. The wind's in a good mood now, young blade. Mind the step. It's icy.
The stone is quiet. On the wall, Tobin grips a lance twice his age and does not let go.
The old lance is warm in your hands, as if someone had only just let go of it.
The relic is dimming. My Patriarch withdrew its blessing. The tithe was... late.
Greenhollow's relic still shines. Here, nothing. I have been asking my Church why.
You refused us, and still I came. The Crown's fields feed my pilgrims too.
Because a relic is a leash, friend. I did not know that. Or I did not wish to.
This stone was broken by a hand, not by time. Kneel, carver. The ash is still warm.
A cart in the ash. A woman's voice: 'The Edge pays on delivery.' A sack of violet glass changes hands.
The heart here is fine. Its line to Kingsreach is cut. Draw a new one. Stone to stone.
Tall one! Snikkit guards the old stone. Very well. Very secretly. Go away.
Snikkit *borrowed* the shiny! Shiny was lonely! Shiny wanted a friend!
Lantern! Warm lantern! Snikkit sees purple coming, tall one. Snikkit's eyes are yours now.
Fine! Fine. Snikkit remembers the mean tall one. Snikkit remembers *everything*.
Child of the ford. We walked out of the ashes, once. Now walk in. Sit. You're home.
{player}. It's me. {ancestor}. You have my stubborn chin. I'd know it anywhere.
Your grandmother's grandmother's grandmother. Or near enough. Stones lose count.
The one who came before you. Still here. Still stubborn. Still proud of you.
Hold? Child, I've been holding. Now it's your turn to be held. Carve.
Five hearts beating. Feel that? The whole Vale hums like a hive in summer.
Still growing. Route the lines toward the Edge. We'll want every spark at the mouth.
